release_read.basis: Q3 beat its own guide on sales (+7.6% cc) and cc EBITDA and FY sales guide raised, but adjusted EPS $0.64 sits below the Nasdaq $0.73 bar, reported FY EBITDA is held at $670-690m (so the Q3 beat is not carried into Q4), and the Q4 guide of +0.5-4.5% sales / $145-165m EBITDA is soft as it laps India GST; China -26% cc, EMEA -5% cc. Mixed print sized at a quarter of the 12% implied move to the downside, given the two prior in-guide prints were sold.

release.headline: Herbalife Achieves Third Quarter Net Sales Growth of 6.0%; Strong Profitability and Robust Operating Cash Flow; Fifth Consecutive Quarter of Expansion

vs_bar.consensus_source: Nasdaq EPS forecast carried in the brief (fallback, 2 estimates; the hunt called this bar disputed, ~20% above what the EBITDA guide supported)
release states Q3 net sales and cc adjusted EBITDA exceeded company guidance; no street figure found in time

key_line.detail: Q4 net sales +0.5% to +4.5% reported (+2.5% to +6.5% cc), adjusted EBITDA $145-165m reported ($155-175m cc); FY reported EBITDA held at $670-690m despite Q3 beating its guide. New $250m three-year buyback, purchases from Q4.

guidance.detail: FY sales raised to +4.9-5.9% reported (from +2.5-5.5%); FY adjusted EBITDA reported unchanged at $670-690m, cc raised to $700-720m. Q4 guide implies a slowdown; street Q4 numbers not found.

call.detail: Call held last night at 17:00 ET; its content was not reviewed within the time budget. No call risk left in today's session.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst action dated 2026-11-03 found in one search; aggregator pages show older targets only. Retail not searched.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 13.71 (+3.24%) vs prev close 13.28; after-hours was 13.88 (+4.5%) and the pre-market sagged to 13.61 by 08:34. Only 7 prints, none in the last 30 minutes, last at 08:34: stale_at_open. Market up modestly (IWM +0.3%). The tape is about 6 points above my frozen release read of -3%, well inside the 12% implied move; the short is losing about 2.8-3.5% against entry 13.24.

thesis_check.note: Short thesis was a soft Q4 guide lapping India GST and an EPS bar above what the guide supports; EPS missed the Nasdaq bar and Q4 is soft, but Q3 beat its own guide, FY sales were raised and the market read it positively overnight.

expected.open_lag_note: Pre-market is stale (7 prints, last 08:34) and already sagging from the +4.5% after-hours, so the open is uncertain and could hold less of the move; an amc gap of ~3% on a mixed print with a soft Q4 guide tends to give part back in the first half hour.

recommendation.reason: De short staat in de pre-market ongeveer 3% verlies, maar de cijfers zelf zijn gemengd (winst per aandeel onder de verwachting, zwakke vierde-kwartaalprognose) en de koers zakte al van +4,5% nabeurs naar ruim +3%. Een gat in de koers zakt na de opening vaak deels terug; daarom pas om 10:00 dekken in plaats van bij de opening. De pre-market handel is dun, dus de opening zelf is onzeker.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de pre-market voor 09:30 weer actief wordt en boven 13,85 (het nabeurse niveau) gaat, dan direct bij de opening dekken.
